# 0.4.18

## 本次更新

- 修复首页推荐“往下加载卡住”：给分页请求加整体超时，并释放卡住的请求门，卡住后会自动进入退避并可重试，不再无限等待、不显示加载中也不报错。
- 修复 Cookie 持久化：只有服务端确认登录有效的 Cookie 集合才会写入持久化快照，滚动分页等未确认的健康检查不再覆盖好快照，减少更新/重启后被迫重新登录。
- 付费/订阅作品现在会正确显示锁标与详情页提示：升级 dakit_web 0.2.5，把 premium/tier 门禁映射为“需要订阅”，不再把打不开的预览当普通图显示成裂图。

- Fixes the home feed pagination getting stuck: every page fetch now has a hard timeout and stalled in-flight requests are released, so the feed enters backoff and can retry instead of waiting forever with no spinner or error.
- Fixes cookie persistence: only a server-confirmed cookie set is written to the persisted snapshot, so unconfirmed health checks during scrolling no longer overwrite good credentials and force a re-login after an update or restart.
- Paid/subscription artwork now shows a lock badge and a detail-page warning: dakit_web 0.2.5 maps premium/tier gates to "subscription required", so inaccessible previews no longer render as broken images.
